controls.name: jawOpen
controls.label: Jaw opening
controls.meaning: Rotates the lower head around an authored jaw pivot; also opens the mouth when lips are not sealed.

controls.name: lipClosure
controls.label: Lip closure
controls.meaning: Seals the lips at 1 independently of jaw rotation; a deliberate simplifying constraint.

controls.name: lipRound
controls.label: Lip rounding
controls.meaning: Narrows and protrudes the authored lips.

controls.name: upperLipRaise
controls.label: Upper lip raise
controls.meaning: Raises the upper lip when lips are not sealed.

controls.name: lowerLipDepress
controls.label: Lower lip lower
controls.meaning: Lowers the lower lip when lips are not sealed.

controls.name: smile
controls.label: Smile
controls.meaning: Raises mouth corners and slightly widens the lips.

controls.name: blinkLeft
controls.label: Left eye blink
controls.meaning: Closes the avatar's left eye, on the viewer's right.

controls.name: blinkRight
controls.label: Right eye blink
controls.meaning: Closes the avatar's right eye, on the viewer's left.

controls.name: headYaw
controls.label: Head turn
controls.meaning: Positive turns the nose toward the viewer's right; limited to ten degrees each way.

controls.name: headPitch
controls.label: Head nod
controls.meaning: Positive points the nose downward; limited to ten degrees each way.

controls.name: headRoll
controls.label: Head tilt
controls.meaning: Positive moves the top of the head toward the viewer's left; limited to ten degrees each way.
